content.comment_body: I plan to use one [product_name] ([article_no]), two [product_name] modules, and one [product_name] operator device. I'm not sure about the exact power requirement for these modules. Because I have limited space, I'm looking for a compact power switch. I'm uncertain whether these modules have built-in switching voltage regulators—if yes, I lean toward the [product_name] power supply 24V / 1.3A; if they're using linear voltage regulation, I'd prefer the [product_name] power supply 12V / 1.9A. Thank you!
You can check the power consumption details in chapter A (8, 10 & 19) of the manual. See: [url]
Be sure to consider the devices that your [product_name] will control. Personally, I recommend using 24V DC.

I agree, 24V DC is preferable since the [product_name] module operates with either 12V or 24V DC and the operator device supply is 24V AC/DC. Hope this helps. The [product_name] power supply works for the system and its associated modules.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unsure about the power requirements for assembling a system with particular automation modules. There's confusion about voltage regulation (switching vs. linear) and which [product_name] power supply to choose. While documentation is referenced, users find determining the exact power supply challenging. Experience-based recommendations lean toward using 24V DC, but a lack of clear and fast guidance remains, pointing to a need for easier compatibility information.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants clear instructions for figuring out the power needs and choosing the right [product_name] power supply for their configuration. They hope for a simple way to ensure compatibility and save space, without needing to review extensive manuals.
